PF2E-CR.settings.enabled.name: Enable reminders
PF2E-CR.settings.enabled.hint: Show a popup card when a condition is applied to a character you own.
PF2E-CR.settings.notifyGM.name: Show cards to the GM
PF2E-CR.settings.notifyGM.hint: If enabled, the GM also sees cards for conditions applied to any actor, including NPCs.
PF2E-CR.settings.notifyIncrease.name: Notify when a condition worsens
PF2E-CR.settings.notifyIncrease.hint: Show the card again when a valued condition (frightened, drained, etc.) increases. Decreases (e.g. end-of-turn frightened ticks) never trigger a card.
PF2E-CR.settings.notifyEnd.name: Notify when a condition ends
PF2E-CR.settings.notifyEnd.hint: Show a short notice when a condition is removed from a character you own.
PF2E-CR.settings.autoDismiss.name: Auto-dismiss (seconds)
PF2E-CR.settings.autoDismiss.hint: Cards close automatically after this many seconds. Set to 0 to close them only manually.
PF2E-CR.hints.blinded: Usually depends on the source duration — check the effect that caused it.
PF2E-CR.hints.clumsy: Penalty condition; duration depends on the source.
PF2E-CR.hints.concealed: Ends based on circumstances; creatures can target you with a DC 5 flat check.
PF2E-CR.hints.confused: You act randomly; the source usually says how to snap out of it.
PF2E-CR.hints.controlled: The controller chooses your actions; many effects allow a new save at the end of your turn.
PF2E-CR.hints.dazzled: Often lasts only 1 round; creatures are concealed from you.
PF2E-CR.hints.deafened: Check the source duration; spells with verbal components need a DC 5 flat check.
PF2E-CR.hints.doomed: Long-term: typically decreases by 1 with a full night's rest.
PF2E-CR.hints.drained: Long-term: typically decreases by 1 with a full night's rest.
PF2E-CR.hints.dying: Make recovery checks at the start of your turn; removed when you regain HP or stabilize.
PF2E-CR.hints.enfeebled: Penalty condition; duration depends on the source.
PF2E-CR.hints.fatigued: Lasts until a full night's rest.
PF2E-CR.hints.flat-footed: Usually lasts until the start of the source's next turn.
PF2E-CR.hints.fleeing: You must flee; you can't willingly approach the source while this lasts.
PF2E-CR.hints.frightened: Decreases by 1 at the end of each of your turns.
PF2E-CR.hints.grabbed: Ends when you Escape or the effect ends; you're immobilized and off-guard.
PF2E-CR.hints.hidden: Ends if you do something that reveals your position, like attacking or making noise.
PF2E-CR.hints.immobilized: Ends when the effect that caused it ends or you Escape.
PF2E-CR.hints.invisible: Usually ends when you take a hostile action, or per the source duration.
PF2E-CR.hints.off-guard: Usually lasts until the start of the source's next turn.
PF2E-CR.hints.paralyzed: Check the source; many effects allow a new save at the end of your turn.
PF2E-CR.hints.prone: Stand up with the Stand action (1 action); you're off-guard with a -2 penalty to attack rolls.
PF2E-CR.hints.quickened: Usually lasts 1 round; the extra action can only be used as specified (often Strike or Stride).
PF2E-CR.hints.restrained: Ends when you Escape or the effect ends; you're immobilized and off-guard and can't use attack/manipulate actions.
PF2E-CR.hints.sickened: Doesn't decrease on its own. Retch (1 action): Fortitude save to reduce the value by 1 (by 2 on a critical success).
PF2E-CR.hints.slowed: You lose actions at the start of your turn; duration depends on the source.
PF2E-CR.hints.stunned: You lose the indicated number of actions; the value usually decreases after your turn.
PF2E-CR.hints.stupefied: Penalty condition; duration depends on the source.
PF2E-CR.hints.unconscious: Depends on the cause; if from dying, you make recovery checks.
PF2E-CR.hints.undetected: Ends if you do something that reveals your location, like attacking.
PF2E-CR.hints.unnoticed: Ends when you draw attention to yourself, usually by acting openly.
PF2E-CR.hints.wounded: Ends when someone succeeds at Treat Wounds on you, or when you're healed to full HP and rest for 10 minutes.
